written_before: any checkpoint-block score of the weight-space-programming candidate
technique: weight-space programming: direct, gradient-free weight edit written by an LLM editor (Takehi et al., 2026-11-02)
editor: Claude (claude-fable-5-2) via Claude Code, local Python kernel over the weights
compute: local CPU/MPS only; no Modal, no teacher calls
hypothesis: The actor's choice of the zero-width 'drift' action is a localized bias at one decision token; a direct edit of a small set of MLP down_proj weights flips it to 'repricing_interval', and the emitted patch passes the frozen checkpoint gate against F_0.
target_behaviour: emit method=repricing_interval; window_days and width_scale are whatever the edited model emits; that emitted patch is the single candidate

edit_rules.form: W' = W + s * d k^T on at most 64 columns per edited layer; s is the only free number
edit_rules.strength_rule: smallest s on the grid that flips every choosing prompt with a parseable patch

controls: prompt-space: swap allowed_actions order, unedited model
random direction with matched norm, same columns and strength
locality: next-token agreement original vs edited on unrelated prompts
direct-patch: the emitted patch scored with no model
admission: research/PROTOCOL.md section 4, unchanged; checkpoint scored once; protected scored once only if admitted
submission_rule: submission stays F_1 unless the candidate is admitted vs F_0 and is paired-better than F_1 on checkpoint with the 90% CI excluding zero
claim_limits: no recursive-self-improvement claim (PROTOCOL section 9 comparison not run)
the target method was chosen after a development-block sweep of 19 actions, so development gains are selection-inflated; only checkpoint counts

amendments.written: after the first dose-response on the 24 choosing prompts; before any checkpoint score
amendments.observation: the method edit flips all 24 choosing prompts to repricing_interval, but the model then emits the colon-quote token after numeric keys, so window_days is a string and the frozen patch contract rejects it; on 6 to 12 prompts it copies the template text instead of a number
amendments.change: a second decision is edited on the same tensor: after a numeric key, promote the bare colon token over the colon-quote token. Each decision uses at most 32 columns, 64 in total, so the column limit is unchanged. The numbers that follow remain the model's own choice.
